title: City Budget Wrap-Up
summary:
*   City leaders convened a special work session to finalize budget discussions.
*   The meeting's sole purpose was a wrap-up discussion on the Capital Improvement Program (CIP) and operating budgets.
*   The work session lasted three hours, from 9 AM to 12 PM.
*   No specific policy decisions or public hearings were listed as part of this meeting.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING - August 31, 1988 - 9:00 A.M Council Chambers, 307 VM-st Second
Street, Austin, Texas Mayor Cooke called to order the special called meeting of the
Council, noting the absence of Councilmembers Urdy and Humphrey.
Mayor Cooke noted the purpose of the meeting was a worksession to hold wrap-up discussion
on CIP/ Operating budgets.
The meeting adjourned at 12:00 noon.
